messages:
Zoe Liu: quick sync thread for postmortem follow-ups from the 03/21 canary regression. goal: codify guardrails so we don't need large manual rollbacks. i'll enumerate items; please ack+claim.
Ben Ortiz: ack. i'll take auto-rollback harness work if no one else wants it. want a deterministic sim that runs in CI.
Zoe Liu: Action A: auto-rollback harness + CI sim. owner: @Ben. scope: deterministic canary replay + failure injection. ETA: 10d. priority: high.
Samir Desai: i can take quarantine API and CLI controls. propose `flagctl quarantine --flag-id FID --reason "incident" --expire 15m`. also add operator ACLs.
Zoe Liu: Action B: emergency_quarantine API + CLI + ACLs. owner: @Samir. ETA: 12d.
Ava - SRE: add runbook change: when quarantine is used, page owner + oncall, automatically mark the flag as "isolated" in the dashboard. scheduling a scenario drill after QA.
Zoe Liu: Action C: runbook + drill. owner: @Ava. ETA: 7d.
Ben Ortiz: for the harness, i'll add a small config block so CI can vary sample_rate and fail thresholds. snippet: ```yaml
canary:
  sample_rate: 0.005
  monitor: [error_rate, p95_latency]
  thresholds:
    error_rate: 0.015
  rollback_action: quarantine_flag
```
Maria Chen: also want a default blast-radius policy. proposal: new flags default to 0.1% exposed for 24h, then auto-increment to 1% if no alerts. internal builds can start at 5%.
Samir Desai: Action D: default rollout policy + staged increment. owner: @Samir. ETA: 5d.
Ava - SRE: telemetry ask: record per-flag delta metrics (control vs treatment) at 30s granularity and emit anomaly events when treatment delta > threshold. wire to oncall alerts and to the incident board.
Zoe Liu: Action E: telemetry enrichment (per-flag delta, 30s anomaly). owner: @Ava. ETA: 3w.
Ben Ortiz: add a quick predictive risk score at rollout-time: inputs = historical regressions for the repo, flag surface area (api vs infra), sample_rate, owner slack activity. simple score 0-100. value: helps gating. owner: @Ben. ETA: 3w.
Maria Chen: Action F: rollout risk scoring heuristic. owner: @Ben. please document inputs and a human-readable justification for thresholds.
Zoe Liu: Action G: incident-pattern tracker (collect tags: "canary-regression", "feature-flag", "blast-radius") and surface if 3+ similar incidents in 90d so we can propose default config changes. owner: @Ava. ETA: 30d.
Samir Desai: one more operational detail: make `--force-rollback` a guarded CLI flag that requires two approvers unless used by a SRE in an active incident.
Maria Chen: summary of owners: Ben (harness + risk score), Samir (quarantine API + rollout defaults), Ava (telemetry + runbooks + tracker), Zoe (coord + rollout policy). please paste PR links and commit SHAs here when opened. weekly checkin Friday 09:30 PT.
deploy-bot: deploy 57af3c -> staging by @Ben succeeded :white_check_mark:
Zoe Liu: thanks — will follow up with a lightweight tracking table in the incident board. ping me if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
